description: This file defines the interface 'EntityDisplayRepositoryInterface' for managing entity display configurations in Drupal, including methods for retrieving view and form modes, display settings, and associated display objects.

classes.name: EntityDisplayRepositoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for an entity display repository managing view and form modes, display settings, and display objects.

methods.name: getAllViewModes
methods.description: Retrieves info for all entity types' view modes.

methods.name: getViewModes
methods.description: Retrieves view mode info for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getAllFormModes
methods.description: Retrieves info for all entity types' form modes.

methods.name: getFormModes
methods.description: Retrieves form mode info for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getViewModeOptions
methods.description: Returns view mode options for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getFormModeOptions
methods.description: Returns form mode options for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getViewModeOptionsByBundle
methods.description: Returns enabled view mode options for an entity type and bundle.

methods.name: getFormModeOptionsByBundle
methods.description: Returns enabled form mode options for an entity type and bundle.

methods.name: getViewDisplay
methods.description: Gets the entity view display for a bundle and view mode.

methods.name: getFormDisplay
methods.description: Gets the entity form display for a bundle and form mode.
